evidence.balcony: SOURCES DISAGREE: ApartmentList unit amenities list 'Patio / balcony' (description mentions a 'terrace' with park views), but the official features list (detailed) has no balcony, and 2b2b plans B2A, B2D, B2E on ApartmentList show none. https://www.apartmentlist.com/ma/boston/bell-olmsted-park ; https://www.bellolmstedpark.com/amenities/
evidence.in_unit_wd: Official: 'Washer and Dryer'; W/D drawn on all 2b2b plans; ApartmentList FAQ confirms in-unit laundry. https://www.bellolmstedpark.com/amenities/
evidence.hardwood: Official: 'Hardwood-inspired Flooring' and 'Bedroom Carpeting' (not real hardwood); ApartmentList says 'Hardwood floors'. https://www.bellolmstedpark.com/amenities/
evidence.ev_charging: ApartmentList community amenities: 'Car charging'; not mentioned on official site. https://www.apartmentlist.com/ma/boston/bell-olmsted-park
